context: Sho and Hina play a treasure hunt game.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: しょう、宝物、本当、探そう。
lines.en: Sho, let's find the treasure — really!
lines.style: Bright, eager opening with infectious certainty. Quick tempo. Natural eight-year-old energy — unself-conscious and warm. Lean forward on the proposal.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Yeah, I really will try my best.
lines.style: Quiet agreement, genuine commitment underneath. Soft voice, steady pace. No performance — just a six-year-old being serious about something that matters.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: This is so fun when we do it together.
lines.style: Warm appreciation, sun-bright but not manic. Medium pace, easy cadence. The contentment of inclusion in her own words.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Quick, genuine triumph — no fake big performance. Small voice suddenly lit up. Breathless with the actual discovery of it, not the telling of it.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Pure admiration without irony, delivered bright and clean. Open-hearted closing. Eight-year-old generosity at full volume.
